description.en: Products, projects, tasks, changelog and delivery acceptance that coding agents keep current, closed every week by an agent-written R&D report.
description.zh-CN: 产品、项目、任务、变更记录和交付验收由 coding agent 随手维护，每周由 Agent 写一份研发周报闭环。

agentPrompts:
Write last week's R&D weekly report: what shipped in each product, what is in progress, the open needs, and the deliveries waiting for my acceptance.
生成上周研发周报：各产品上线了什么、进行中的工作、还有什么需求、哪些交付在等我验收。

Connect this code repository to the R&D desk, so every coding agent working here updates its task and logs a changelog row when it merges.
把这个代码仓库接到研发管理台，让在这里干活的 coding agent 都会更新任务，并在合并时写一条变更记录。

Package last week's merged changes into deliveries I can accept, with acceptance steps written from each task's criteria.
把上周合并的改动整理成待我验收的交付，并根据每个任务的验收标准写好验收步骤。
